bugClasses.statement: A hand-mounted plugin object bypasses the Loader's export unwrapping and the real service-resolution topology, so the suite can stay green while the shipped entry is broken. At least one keyless test must drive the real Loader/export path end-to-end.

A syntactically accepted configuration value is not necessarily evaluated at the location that read it. Every documented interpolation site is verified mechanically, and expected-output production asserts semantic possibilities (registered tools, no UNKNOWN_TOOL) independently of the recorded fixture.

HTTP readiness, build success, and a boot manifest are different facts, and a replacement service cannot prove that an existing page changed. Acceptance names the exact origin and observes the requested change there from outside the process.

Process attribution requires a conjunction of independent evidence; a shared text prefix is not a protocol. Informational and fatal diagnostics sharing one namespace use exact, narrow exclusions and stay fail-closed for unknown fatal lines.
